title: onboard-elysium-13b-v1.0-performance-metadata-and-automate-changelog
author: Priya Kapoor
body: Onboard elysium-13b v1.0 into the model registry with metadata, curated performance profiles, and an automated changelog entry pipeline. Motivation: Elysium 13B is a new community model with strong on-device throughput and competitive quality for conversation and instruction tasks. We need canonical metadata so the serving runtime can pick kernel/quantization profiles and so the Console can show verified perf characteristics. This PR provides: - model metadata (schema v2) with tokenizer, supported formats, recommended softmax/cache settings - hardware performance profiles for common GPU classes (A100, H100, T4) and quantized variants - small integration test suite to validate metadata -> perf profile mapping - automation script (scripts/changelog-sync.py) that appends generated release notes to models/CHANGELOG.md when new model versions are added; CI job to validate changelog formatting - docs updates (docs/models/elysium-13b.md) with notes on recommended serving configs and known limitations Checklist: - [x] metadata JSON follows registry schema v2 and passes schema validation - [x] perf profiles benchmarked on internal perf lab and annotated with SLOs/99th pct latency - [x] changelog automation added and validated in CI - [x] integration tests added and passing in CI - [ ] coordinate internal release so Dedicated has pinned artifacts (follow-up ticket ENG-4903) Notes on scope: this PR does NOT change runtime code; it provides metadata and automation that the Console and deploy tooling will consume. Follow-up work (ENG-4903) schedules rollout to Dedicated and Private deploy customers and will include optionally pinned quantized artifacts for older GPU types.
commits: Initial metadata and perf profiles (models/elysium-13b/v1.0/metadata.json, perf-profiles/elysium-13b-v1.0.yaml)
Add changelog-sync automation script and CI job (scripts/changelog-sync.py, .github/workflows/changelog-generator.yml)
Integration tests for metadata -> perf mapping (tests/integration/test_elysium_metadata.py)
Docs: add model page and usage notes (docs/models/elysium-13b.md)
Address reviewer feedback: add quantization profile for int8 and improve changelog format
review_comments: Diego Martinez requested adding an int8 quantization profile for 4-bit and 8-bit fallback (comment: please attach the quantization config we used on H100).
Priya: Added elysium-13b-v1.0-int8 profile and included bench results from perf-lab (see perf-profiles/).
Aisha: asked to tighten changelog formatting to include a short summary and a 'compatibility' flag; updated changelog-sync to validate both fields.
Ethan: requested additional unit-test coverage for the metadata schema edge cases; added two tests to cover missing tokenizer fields and unsupported formats.
Approvals: Diego approved after quantization profile added; Aisha approved after changelog validations; Ethan approved after tests pass.
release_notes: Added Elysium 13B v1.0: metadata, verified performance profiles (A100/H100/T4), int8 quantization profile, changelog automation to surface model releases. See models/elysium-13b/v1.0 for details.
